cohort: Patients receiving prenatal care between 2015 to 2018 at Penn State Health Hershey Medical Center
finding: Prenatal patients cared for by FM physicians had a higher burden of social risk factors compared to those cared for by OB/Gyn, but had a lower rate of total Cesarean-sections.
mod_finding: FM patients had a lower rate of total Cesarean-sections (C-section), including primary and repeat, when compared with OB/Gyn.
